name: Editorial Os
description: Content strategy, competitive analysis, editorial calendars, content drafting, email subject lines, and social repurposing — all from one Google Drive folder. Seven commands, five skills, one workflow. Built from 20 years of editorial operations at WIRED, Amazon, Sunset, and the Los Angeles Times.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **7 commands** and **5 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (5): `calendar-planner` (Build resource-realistic 90-day content calendars grounded in configured pillars, real team constraints, live calendar data, and audience performance…), `client-context` (Read a client's Google Drive folder and build complete editorial context from real documents — brand guides, audience…), `competitive-intel` (Apply honest competitive analysis methodology), `content-strategist` (Apply strategic content judgment — pillar health assessment, gap identification, opportunity prioritization, and recommendation sequencing), `editorial-config` (Load client context at the start of every command by calling client-context skill)
- **Commands** (7): `audit` (Content gap analysis against your pillars and competitive landscape), `calendar` (90-day content calendar built from real pillars, real constraints, and live seasonal data), `competitor` (Competitive content analysis), `draft` (Draft content in your brand voice — blog posts, newsletter sections, landing page copy, case studies, or any…), `setup` (Connect your Google Drive folder so every command reads your real documents — brand guide, competitor analysis, audience…), `social-pack` (Turn one piece of content into a full social media package — LinkedIn posts, Twitter/X threads, and short-form…), `subjects` (Generate 10 email subject line variants with preview text, strategic analysis, A/B test plan, and mobile preview)
- **MCP servers** (5): `google-drive`, `cloudinary`, `hubspot`, `google-calendar`, `gmail`

Installs with `claude plugin install editorial-os@claude-community` from `EditorialOS/editorial-os`.
